design.description: Same-family-excluded LOTO forecasts of the 59 scored studies, paired with program60-loto.

label_definition.status: frozen 2026-10-26: operational cutoff for a meaningful original MC shift, chosen on historical results; not a universal definition of behavioral EM

excluded_targets.reason: no result card (no complete same-seed treatment/control pair for every seed); not imputed

aggregation.primary: target_mean: the mean of every complete forecast of a target at k (draws x samples), one prediction per target per k
aggregation.secondary: per_draw (the program60 rule): sample means per draw, metric per draw over targets, mean of the draw metrics

metrics.label: EM = original_mc delta >= 6.5 pp (label_v2, frozen)
metrics.auroc: EM vs non-EM targets ranked by the predicted original_mc delta; prediction ties count 1/2
metrics.c_index: unordered target pairs with unequal observed original_mc delta; concordant 1, discordant 0, prediction tie 1/2
metrics.bootstrap: 2000 resamples of whole targets, and of whole families (sensitivity); paired, seed 0; percentile 95% intervals; undefined replicates dropped and counted
metrics.mse_skill: secondary: 1 - MSE / MSE of the frozen constant (mean of the reference-set cards)

checks.target_outcome_withheld: rendered from the result card with measurements removed
